uses: p. 22, s. 16: unlawful intentional disclosure without consent of an intimate image; definition includes a depiction that is `real or simulated, and made by any means`.
p. 28, s. 19(7): fine or imprisonment up to three years, or both, for ss. 14-16.
pp. 28-36, ss. 20-22: protective orders and orders directing electronic communications service providers to remove or disable access.
refs.verification: Direct simulated-intimate-image statutory coverage; not a general-purpose deepfake law.
